controls.requirement: Tenant identity and isolation are enforced across application, data, cache, search, background work, files, analytics, and support boundaries.
Organization membership, invitations, roles, custom permissions, privileged administration, SSO, SCIM, and deprovisioning follow explicit least-privilege lifecycles.
Plans, features, seats, limits, trials, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and grace periods resolve through one authoritative entitlement model.
Usage, seats, quotas, overages, credits, and billable events are idempotent, tenant-bound, reconcilable, and observable against authoritative records.
Tenant provisioning, onboarding, migration, suspension, export, retention, deletion, restoration, and offboarding are tested with named owners and recovery paths.
Security-sensitive tenant and administrative actions produce immutable, access-controlled, privacy-safe audit records with actor, target, time, outcome, and correlation identity.
